3. Changed files (commit e51844ab8)
- plugins/pipeline-core/lib/hardened-private-directory.mjs: new export ensureAgentPipelineRoot(common, options) returning { path, created, repaired, advisory, detail }; D0 posture constant AGENT_PIPELINE_ROOT_INSECURE_OWNED_POSTURE = "repair" (the single switch; options.posture overrides per call; any value but "repair" is read as refuse); advisory constant AGENT_PIPELINE_ROOT_REPAIRED_ADVISORY = "PB-ROOT-REPAIRED". Existing ensureHardenedPrivateDirectory and its callers are unchanged. New imports are only node:fs members and two members of the already-imported windows-private-state.mjs (no new module edge).
- plugins/pipeline-core/lib/guard-maintenance-window.mjs: the single NEVER_LIFTABLE_KERNEL_PATHS entry for hardened-private-directory.mjs (plus a 2-line comment). No guard refusal at either Edit or the commit.

Behaviour. Absent: created through the existing machinery. Present and secure: returned. Present and insecure and owned by the current user: win32 observes once with observeWindowsPrivatePath, requires a non-reparse path whose owner is the current principal (judged by the module's own evaluator on the observation with a clean DACL, BEFORE any hardening, because the hardening script takes ownership), then hardenWindowsPrivateDirectory, then an explicit assess; anything but secure throws PB-WINDOWS-ASSURANCE and is never reported as repaired. POSIX: the existing helper does not assess an existing segment's mode, so the entry point does (mode & 0o077, owner uid vs getuid()), then chmods 0o700 through an O_NOFOLLOW|O_DIRECTORY descriptor bound to the assessed dev/inode, then re-lstat; not private afterwards throws PB-ROOT-INSECURE. Foreign owner, reparse point, non-directory, unobservable assurance, or posture refuse: refused with the family's typed errors and left untouched (PB-WINDOWS-ASSURANCE on win32, PB-ROOT-INSECURE elsewhere, PB-DIRECTORY, PB-ANCHOR). PB-ROOT-INSECURE and PB-ROOT-REPAIRED are new codes in the PB-* family.
